title: Environment and Nature
description: Explore key environmental topics — from climate change and pollution to conservation and renewable energy — while building the vocabulary and language skills needed to discuss global issues. This course targets A2 completers who want to engage with real-world topics in English.

topics.title: Module 1: Climate Change and Global Warming

lessons.title: Key Terms: Climate Change and Global Warming

content.content: {"time":1700000201000,"blocks":[{"id":"aA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Climate change refers to long-term shifts in global temperatures and weather patterns. While some climate change is natural, since the 20th century human activities have been the main driver."}},{"id":"dD4eE5fF6g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary:"}},{"id":"gG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["global warming — the rise in Earth's average temperature due to greenhouse gases","greenhouse gas — gases (CO₂, methane) that trap heat in the atmosphere","carbon footprint — the total CO₂ emissions produced by a person, event, or product","fossil fuels — coal, oil, and gas formed from ancient organisms","emissions — gases released into the air, especially from burning fuel","deforestation — the clearing of forests, which reduces CO₂ absorption","sea level rise — the increase in ocean levels due to melting ice and warmer water","extreme weather events — floods, droughts, hurricanes intensified by climate change"]}},{"id":"jJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful phrases for discussing causes:"}},{"id":"mM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'One of the main causes of climate change is the burning of fossil fuels.'","'As a result of deforestation, carbon dioxide levels have increased.'","'This has led to a significant rise in global temperatures.'"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: One of the main causes of climate change is the burning of fossil fuels.

pairs.right: total CO₂ produced by an activity or person
gas that traps heat in the atmosphere

options: The amount of carbon found underground
The total CO₂ emissions caused by an individual or activity

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a fossil fuel?

lessons.title: Cause and Effect Language for Environmental Topics

content.content: {"time":1700000202000,"blocks":[{"id":"pP6qQ7rR8s","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"When discussing environmental issues, we often need to explain causes and their effects. Here are the key language structures:"}},{"id":"sS9tT0uU1v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Showing cause:"}},{"id":"vV2wW3xX4y","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'Due to / Because of + noun: Due to rising temperatures, glaciers are melting faster.","'As a result of + noun: As a result of deforestation, many species have lost their habitat.","'Since / Because + clause: Because emissions have increased, the atmosphere has warmed.'"]}},{"id":"yY5zA6bB7c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Showing effect:"}},{"id":"cC8dD9eE0f","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'This leads to / causes + noun: Pollution leads to serious health problems.'","'As a result, + clause: As a result, many coastal areas are at risk of flooding.'","'This has resulted in + noun: Burning fossil fuels has resulted in higher CO₂ levels.'"]}},{"id":"fF1gG2hH3i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Discourse markers for sequencing: firstly, furthermore, in addition, however, on the other hand, in contrast, consequently, therefore, as a consequence"}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Due to rising temperatures, Arctic ice is melting rapidly.

mistakeItems.text: Due to deforestation leads to habitat loss.
mistakeItems.correctText: Due to deforestation, many species have lost their habitat.

mistakeItems.text: Because of the emissions, so temperatures have risen.
mistakeItems.correctText: Because of the emissions, temperatures have risen.

content.text: Due to [rising] temperatures, Arctic ice is melting rapidly. As a result, sea levels [are increasing], which [threatens] many coastal communities. [Furthermore], the loss of ice affects ocean currents and weather patterns around the world.

pairs.english: Due to deforestation, many animal species are losing their natural habitat.
pairs.russian: Из-за вырубки лесов многие виды животных теряют свою естественную среду обитания.

pairs.english: As a result of rising sea levels, coastal cities are increasingly at risk.
pairs.russian: В результате повышения уровня моря прибрежные города подвергаются всё большей угрозе.

content.content: {"time":1700000203000,"blocks":[{"id":"iI4jJ5kK6l","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Pollution takes many forms, and each has serious consequences for ecosystems and human health."}},{"id":"lL7mM8nN9o","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Air pollution: Caused by vehicle exhaust, industrial emissions, and burning waste. It leads to respiratory diseases (asthma, lung cancer) and contributes to acid rain."}},{"id":"oO0pP1qQ2r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Water pollution: Caused by agricultural runoff (pesticides, fertilisers), industrial waste, and plastic waste. It contaminates drinking water and kills aquatic life."}},{"id":"rR3sS4tT5u","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Soil pollution: Caused by chemicals, heavy metals, and improper waste disposal. It reduces the fertility of farmland and enters the food chain."}},{"id":"uU6vV7wW8x","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Noise pollution: Caused by traffic, construction, and industry. It affects mental health and sleep quality."}},{"id":"xX9yY0zA1b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary:"}},{"id":"bB2cC3dD4e","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["toxic — poisonous","contaminate — to make something impure or unsafe","sewage — waste water from homes and industry","pesticides — chemicals used to kill pests in agriculture","runoff — water that flows off land into rivers and seas"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Air pollution is caused by vehicle exhaust and industrial emissions.

guessItems.hint: To make something impure or unsafe
Waste water from homes and factories
Water that flows off land into rivers

options: To make something impure or dangerous

lessons.title: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle: Waste Management Language

content.content: {"time":1700000204000,"blocks":[{"id":"eE5fF6gG7h","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Effective waste management is one of the most important environmental challenges. The three core principles are the 3Rs: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle."}},{"id":"hH8iI9jJ0k","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Reduce — using less in the first place: fewer plastic bags, less packaging, less food waste."}},{"id":"kK1lL2mM3n","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Reuse — using items again instead of throwing them away: refillable water bottles, second-hand clothes."}},{"id":"nN4oO5pP6q","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Recycle — processing used materials to make new products: glass, paper, metal, plastic."}},{"id":"qQ7rR8sS9t","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary:"}},{"id":"tT0uU1vV2w","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["landfill — an area of land where waste is buried","biodegradable — able to decompose naturally (opposite: non-biodegradable)","compost — organic waste broken down to fertilise soil","single-use plastic — plastic designed to be used once and thrown away","upcycling — creatively reusing materials to make something of higher value"]}},{"id":"wW3xX4yY5z","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Discussing solutions:"}},{"id":"zA6bB7cC8d","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'One effective way to tackle waste is to...'","'Governments should introduce legislation to reduce...'","'Consumers can make a difference by choosing...'"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Plastic bags are not biodegradable and will remain in the environment for hundreds of years.

pairs.right: творческая переработка в нечто более ценное

tasks.sentence: Plastic bags are not ___ and will remain in the environment for hundreds of years.

subtopics.title: 4.1 Types and Benefits of Renewable Energy

lessons.title: Renewable Energy Sources and Their Advantages

content.content: {"time":1700000205000,"blocks":[{"id":"dD9eE0fF1g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Renewable energy comes from sources that are naturally replenished and do not run out. Unlike fossil fuels, they produce little or no greenhouse gas emissions."}},{"id":"gG2hH3iI4j","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Main types of renewable energy:"}},{"id":"jJ5kK6lL7m","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Solar energy — energy from the sun, captured by solar panels. Clean, increasingly affordable.","Wind energy — energy from wind, captured by turbines. Most efficient offshore.","Hydroelectric power — energy from flowing water (rivers, dams). Reliable but can affect local ecosystems.","Geothermal energy — heat from inside the Earth. Used mainly in volcanic regions (e.g. Iceland).","Biomass energy — energy from organic matter (wood, crops). Can be carbon-neutral."]}},{"id":"mM8nN9oO0p","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Advantages of renewable energy:"}},{"id":"pP1qQ2rR3s","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Reduces dependence on fossil fuels","Lowers carbon emissions and combats climate change","Creates new jobs in the green economy","Energy security — countries don't need to import fuel"]}},{"id":"sS4tT5uU6v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Challenges: High initial installation costs, weather dependency (sun, wind), and storage problems for electricity."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity without producing any harmful emissions.

pairs.english: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity without producing any harmful emissions.
pairs.russian: Солнечные панели преобразуют солнечный свет в электричество, не производя вредных выбросов.

pairs.english: Switching to renewable energy is one of the most effective ways to fight climate change.
pairs.russian: Переход на возобновляемые источники энергии — один из наиболее эффективных способов борьбы с изменением климата.

questions.text: Which type of renewable energy uses the heat from inside the Earth?

content.content: {"time":1700000206000,"blocks":[{"id":"vV7wW8xX9y","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Biodiversity refers to the variety of life on Earth — all species of plants, animals, fungi, and microorganisms. It is vital for healthy ecosystems."}},{"id":"yY0zA1bB2c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Threats to biodiversity:"}},{"id":"cC3dD4eE5f","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Habitat destruction — forests cleared for agriculture or development","Overexploitation — overfishing, poaching, excessive hunting","Invasive species — non-native species that outcompete local ones","Climate change — altering habitats and food sources","Pollution — contaminating water and soil"]}},{"id":"fF6gG7hH8i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Conservation efforts:"}},{"id":"iI9jJ0kK1l","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Establishing national parks and marine reserves","Breeding programmes for endangered species","Reforestation — planting trees to restore forests","International agreements (e.g. the Convention on Biological Diversity)"]}},{"id":"lL2mM3nN4o","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary: endangered species, extinct, ecosystem, habitat, wildlife corridor, conservation, sustainable, biodiversity hotspot"}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Many animal species are endangered due to habitat destruction and poaching.

Many animal species are [endangered] due to habitat [destruction] and poaching. Conservation organisations are working to protect [biodiversity] by establishing national parks and running [breeding] programmes for the most vulnerable species.

options: A species that has already disappeared
A species at risk of becoming extinct
A species that is invasive and spreading
A species that has recovered from extinction

content.content: {"time":1700000207000,"blocks":[{"id":"oO5pP6qQ7r","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"At B1 level, you should be able to discuss environmental problems and propose solutions using appropriate language structures."}},{"id":"rR8sS9tT0u","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Describing problems:"}},{"id":"uU1vV2wW3x","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'One of the most serious environmental problems is...'","'The situation has become increasingly alarming.'","'This poses a serious threat to...'","'Unless action is taken, the consequences could be devastating.'"]}},{"id":"xX4yY5zA6b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Proposing solutions:"}},{"id":"bB7cC8dD9e","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'One effective solution would be to...'","'Governments should invest in...'","'Individuals can contribute by...'","'It is essential that we...'","'A possible approach is to...'"]}},{"id":"eE0fF1gG2h","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing necessity:"}},{"id":"hH3iI4jJ5k","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'We must / need to / have to act now.'","'It is vital/crucial/essential that...'","'There is an urgent need for...'"]}},{"id":"kK6lL7mM8n","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing possibility:"}},{"id":"nN9oO0pP1q","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'It may be possible to...'","'This could lead to significant improvements if...'"]}},{"id":"qQ2rR3sS4t","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":""}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: There is an urgent need for international cooperation to address climate change.

mistakeItems.correctText: It is essential that we reduce our carbon footprint.

pairs.english: There is an urgent need for international cooperation to address climate change.
pairs.russian: Существует острая необходимость в международном сотрудничестве для решения проблемы изменения климата.

pairs.english: Individuals can make a difference by reducing their carbon footprint.
pairs.russian: Каждый человек может внести вклад, сократив свой углеродный след.

content.content: {"time":1700000208000,"blocks":[{"id":"tT5uU6vV7w","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Sustainable living means making choices that reduce your negative impact on the environment and can be maintained long-term without depleting resources."}},{"id":"wW8xX9yY0z","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Sustainable choices in daily life:"}},{"id":"zA1bB2cC3d","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Diet: Eating less meat, buying local and seasonal produce, reducing food waste","Transport: Using public transport, cycling, walking, or driving an electric vehicle","Energy: Using energy-efficient appliances, switching to green energy suppliers","Shopping: Buying second-hand, choosing products with minimal packaging, avoiding fast fashion","Water: Taking shorter showers, collecting rainwater for gardens"]}},{"id":"dD4eE5fF6g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful opinion and recommendation phrases:"}},{"id":"gG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'In my opinion, the most important change individuals can make is...'","'I strongly believe that...'","'It would be a good idea to...'","'I would recommend switching to...'"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I strongly believe that cycling instead of driving is one of the most effective sustainable choices.

items.text: Taking the bus instead of driving
Switching to renewable energy in factories

content.content: {"time":1700000209000,"blocks":[{"id":"jJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Being able to express your opinion and discuss different perspectives on environmental issues is a key B1 skill. Use these structures in discussions and writing tasks."}},{"id":"mM3nN4oO5p","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Giving your opinion:"}},{"id":"pP6qQ7rR8s","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'In my view / opinion, the most urgent issue is...'","'I think / believe / feel that...'","'As far as I'm concerned...'","'From my perspective...'"]}},{"id":"sS9tT0uU1v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Acknowledging other views:"}},{"id":"vV2wW3xX4y","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'Some people argue that..., but...'","'While it is true that..., the fact remains that...'","'On the one hand... On the other hand...'"]}},{"id":"yY5zA6bB7c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Making recommendations:"}},{"id":"cC8dD9eE0f","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'The best approach would be to...'","'I strongly recommend...'","'It is worth considering...'"]}},{"id":"fF1gG2hH3i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Expressing concern:"}},{"id":"iI4jJ5kK6l","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'I am deeply concerned about the state of...'","'It worries me that...'","'The situation is alarming because...'"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: In my view, economic development and environmental protection can go hand in hand.

content.instructions: Express your opinion on climate change aloud
content.targetPhrase: In my opinion, climate change is the most urgent challenge of our time.

content.text: [In my opinion], climate change is the biggest challenge of our time. [On the one hand], many governments have made progress in reducing emissions. [On the other hand], the pace of change is still too slow. [As far as I'm concerned], individual action is important, but real change requires government policy.

pairs.english: In my view, economic development and environmental protection can go hand in hand.
pairs.russian: На мой взгляд, экономическое развитие и охрана окружающей среды могут идти рука об руку.

pairs.english: While it is true that technology can help, we also need to change our behaviour.
pairs.russian: Хотя технологии действительно могут помочь, нам также необходимо изменить своё поведение.
